subject: Clarification needed before starting service
text: Hi, Following your reply, I need a short clarification before I agree to anything further. You mentioned the service could start next week, but the message didn’t say whether that date refers to the survey, the first crew visit, or the actual project start. For scheduling around my own property, I also need to know the earliest and latest hours crews may access the area outside my gate, and whether I need to move the recycling bin beforehand. Your earlier reply noted “standard service terms.” Could you send those terms in plain language or link me to the version applying to residential neighbors? I particularly want to see what happens if access is delayed by weather, whether there is any penalty if I ask to pause midweek, and who is responsible for re-erasing markings after work finishes. Also, you referred to “the usual point of contact.” Is that the project manager named on the notice, a dispatch line, or an online form? If there is a dedicated page for neighbor questions, please send it. I am not looking for marketing details, only the practical facts needed to plan access, parking, and noise around the planned dates. If those answers are already in an attachment, I missed it, so please resend rather than assume. I can review quickly once everything is consolidated. A brief reply is fine, but please number the answers so I can match them to the questions. I will forward any relevant details to the adjacent households if the scope affects their side access as well.
